name: @projexlight/meter-collector
summary: Background rollup service for sdk-meter — consumes per-request UsageEvent.v1 rows + materializes the hourly + daily aggregates that sdk-billing.live reads + the soft-cap counter that meter.check() consults. Decouples the hot request path from the (slower) aggregation path so billing reads never block emit.

events.name: meter-collector.hourly.rolled.v1
events.description: Hourly rollup committed; carries tenant + sku + units totals.

events.name: meter-collector.daily.rolled.v1
events.description: Daily rollup committed; primary input to invoice generation.

events.name: meter-collector.softcap.alert.v1
events.description: Soft-cap counter crossed threshold; downstream WARN headers on meter.check().

hooks.name: startCollector
hooks.description: Background worker — runs rollup passes on the configured cadence.

hooks.name: rollupNow
hooks.description: Force a rollup pass (typically end-of-day cutover or backfill).

hooks.name: warmSoftCapCounter
hooks.description: Pre-populate the soft-cap counter for a tenant + SKU window.

scenarios.title: Start the rollup cadence
scenarios.example_code:
import { startCollector } from '@projexlight/meter-collector';
await startCollector({ interval_sec: 60 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Per-minute pass aggregates new rows + writes hourly + daily rollups. Soft-cap counter stays warm.

scenarios.title: End-of-day cutover triggers daily rollup
scenarios.when_to_use: Midnight per tenant tz — daily rollup commits + drives invoice draft generation in sdk-billing.
scenarios.example_code:
import { rollupNow } from '@projexlight/meter-collector';
await rollupNow({ grain: 'daily', period: '2026-05-26' });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Daily rollup committed. Emits .daily.rolled.v1. sdk-billing picks it up + drafts the invoice.

scenarios.title: Soft cap crossed → WARN headers fire
scenarios.when_to_use: Counter rollup detects a tenant crossed 80% of their plan ceiling — emits .softcap.alert.v1 so the gateway stamps WARN headers on future responses + the tenant-admin UI shows a banner.
scenarios.example_code: // driven by the periodic counter sweep inside startCollector
scenarios.expected_outcome: Future requests on the SKU get a Projex-Warning header. Tenant admin notified.

scenarios.title: Backfill after a meter-emit outage
scenarios.when_to_use: Meter inbox queued up during an outage; rollupNow with a wide window processes everything in order.
scenarios.example_code:
import { rollupNow } from '@projexlight/meter-collector';
await rollupNow({ grain: 'hourly', from: '2026-05-26T00:00Z', to: '2026-05-26T06:00Z' });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Aggregates caught up. Invoice draft regenerates if billing already cut once.

scenarios.title: Lag alarm
scenarios.when_to_use: Rollup lag > threshold for > 5 min — page on-call.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Operator scales collector or investigates upstream.

compliance_posture.notes: Rollups are append-only; corrections happen via reverse-entry events, never overwrite. Daily rollup carries the snapshot hash that the customer invoice references for reproducibility.
